name: history-evidence-coverage
goal: Every indexed page and visual component has retained captures and applicable real source/runtime measurements, with automatic future coverage and honest gaps for blocked historical rebuilds.

evidence: The prepared preview indexes ten revisions, none with full records. Registry audit finds 119 visual modules without a required capture state. Source figures exist, but benchmark series omit focused observations.

Existing loop tests retain focused measurements only in revision details and never assert the history series. Only red/green runs can retain focused captures, so routine or historical collection wrongly requires a fabricated failure. Strengthen the existing loop CLI fixture to cover independent captures and retained series.
Committed test-only revision 3be9f5506. Immutable red record reproduces the missing focused benchmark series and the absence of independent capture collection; both expected assertions fail.
